whenToUse: Mobile app download links in a hero, footer or closing call to action.
A desktop visitor should be able to get the app on their phone (qr).
avoidWhen: The brand guidelines require the stores' official badge artwork — use those files as images with links.
A web app with no store listing — use a button.
a11y: Plain links named by their visible text ("Get it on Google Play") in a list named "Get the app"; icons are aria-hidden.
The QR code has a name that says what scanning does and is hidden on small screens.
